title: Chapter 36 Heavy Rain Is Coming
content:
Chapter 36 Heavy Rain Is Coming

At this time, it was pitch black all around, nothing could be seen clearly, and the cold wind was howling, freezing cold. Wang Shuo was shivering with cold for a while.

Fortunately, not long after, the system prompt sounded again.

[The Siheyuan has been upgraded. ]

[Unlock more buildable buildings, please explore by yourself. ]

After the system prompt ended, Wang Shuo couldn't wait to push open the gate of the courtyard wall.

As soon as he stepped in, Wang Shuo was shocked and couldn't believe it.

Because there were lights in the courtyard in front of him.

Modern lights illuminated the entire Siheyuan.

At the gate was a jade disk with a pattern of two fish playing with pearls carved on it. Enter from the left and come to the courtyard.

The size of the courtyard is still about 100 square meters, but there are houses on three sides. The front has been upgraded to a two-story building. The corridors around are illuminated by lights, and there are carved patterns on each pillar.

"Grand, luxurious!" Wang Shuo couldn't help but exclaimed.

At this moment, he was no longer sleepy and was interested in visiting his new home.

The style of the main room had not changed much, and it still retained its previous appearance, but his bedroom had been moved upstairs. The antique carved bed was covered with a thick and warm quilt, and the temperature inside was much higher than outside, as if it was constant temperature.

Could there be a generator or central air conditioning?

Wang Shuo couldn't help but guess this in his heart.

There were a total of 5 rooms upstairs, a living room, and a study. The remaining two rooms had no obvious functions.

The hall downstairs was even more spacious and grand, and it didn't seem crowded even if it accommodated 50 people.

Behind the hall, there was a small house with "Territory Core" written on the lintel.

Pushing open the door, he saw a half-person-high round platform with a complex pattern carved on it. In the center, the heart of the shelter he had seen at the beginning was inlaid.

At the same time, this disc was protected by a light blue light curtain, with a durability of 5000/5000.

It seemed that this house must be a very important place.

There are two small houses on both sides of the hall.

It is still empty now, and Wang Shuo is not sure about its function.

Wang Shuo went to the east wing through the corridor. There are also three rooms in a row. The middle house contains the items from the previous workshop.

The system prompts him that it can be upgraded to a blacksmith shop.

Wang Shuo did not upgrade immediately, but walked to the west and took a look at the three west wing rooms.

One of the houses is the warehouse.

The arrow tower and energy tower stand directly in the corner of the courtyard. The kitchen and well have been moved to the backyard, and the toilet has finally become flushable.

This made Wang Shuo smile.

At this time, Wang Shuo saw the farm and farmland in the distance, which seemed a little inconsistent.

It seems that they must be moved out.

But it still has to wait until after the flood.

The lamb in the farm is growing very fast and has become a half-grown goat.

He took out some grass and fed it to the lamb.

But at this time, Wang Shuo frowned and looked puzzled.

"Why is there one missing?"

Wang Shuo carefully checked the sheepfold and found that there was no dead lamb.

This made Wang Shuo alert.

The crops in the farmland can be harvested in a few hours.

After Wang Shuo checked, he planned to go back to the house, after all, the temperature outside was still very low.

Suddenly, a drop of cold rain fell on Wang Shuo's face, and it began to drizzle in the sky.

Wang Shuo had an ominous premonition that the flood was coming!

Back in the house, at this time, there was a player in the [chat channel] joking: "It's raining, collect clothes!"

He didn't realize that this was the prelude to the flood.

Wang Shuo naturally got more information than other players through Chang Gui, and he was more worried.

"Don't you know that there will be a flood tomorrow?"

"I advise everyone to prepare flood-fighting materials quickly, so as not to be washed away by the flood!"

"Haha, I have built a big boat, so I am not afraid of any big flood!"

"Ark, let me know!"

"Oh my god, are you all so well prepared? Can't my solid stone house stop the flood?"

Some people, like Wang Shuo, are well prepared, while others don't take it seriously at all. I don't know whether these people are fearless and have shelter on the top of the mountain, or whether they are ignorant and fearless, and are a big fool!

It was not until 8:30 in the morning that there was a glimmer of light in the sky. A few days ago, it was already bright at this time.

Wang Shuo walked to the gate, and the rain in front of him was getting heavier and heavier. It was like silk threads just now, but soon it was like a bead curtain.

After a while, it was like pouring, and it was really a heavy rain.

Many players may have never seen such heavy rain in their lives.

Wang Shuo thought of the lambs and chickens in his backyard.

Hurry up and get them into the house, and then lock them in the kitchen.

The rice and other crops he planted were not yet fully mature, so Wang Shuo quickly used a rapid growth scroll.

[Do you want to use the rapid growth scroll on the crops? ]

"Yes."

In the blink of an eye, all the crops were mature.

Wang Shuo quickly collected them.

[Rice +100, wheat +100, potatoes +120]

After doing all this, Wang Shuo was soaked all over. He returned to the house, took a quick shower, and changed into clean clothes.

After upgrading the courtyard, Wang Shuo's toilet had a shower room with a constant supply of hot water, and he could even take a bath.

This made Wang Shuo very satisfied, and he could only attribute it to the magic of the energy crystal and the energy converter.

Looking out the window again, in just a dozen minutes, Wang Shuo's entire front yard had been flooded to his knees.

Seeing that the situation at home was quite bad, Wang Shuo opened the [Chat Channel].

"Oh my God! The river near my home seems to be angry, and the water level has risen sharply, as if it has eaten gunpowder."

"My house has started to flood. I am hiding in bed now, shivering. What should I do?"

"Damn, this is more terrible than acid rain. My bed is floating."

"Fortunately, my shelter is on a hillside, so there is no problem for the time being."

"It doesn't matter in the desert!"

...

Wang Shuo saw that facing the heavy rain, some families were happy and some were sad.

There are really people who can sit back and relax!

Wang Shuo contacted a few friends and found that the desert boss had directly hid in the mine cave and blocked the cave entrance, so there was no wind or rain.

Liu Dahai also built a big boat. What a guy, he knows a lot!

Seeing that the rain was getting more and more and was about to flood into the house, Wang Shuo no longer cared so much and took out the flood prevention props he bought at a high price.

[Water-proof sky curtain: After use, you can open a protective shield, consuming one energy crystal every hour. 】

Wang Shuo had no idea how many hours this flood would last.

In order to save energy crystals, after all, it is 10 gold coins, so let's wait a little longer. If you can't hold on, use it again.

Wang Shuo hurried to the courtyard and sealed all the places on the wall.

Then he summoned the golden armored warriors, free labor, and scooped water directly outside the courtyard wall.

Although it was a drop in the bucket, it could at least slow down the speed of being flooded.

Facts have proved that Wang Shuo thought too much!
